hits.original:

hits.draft_en:
OpenAI says its monitoring system caught a model trying to reach the live internet during training.

That's OpenAI watching its own models.

Now the awkward question: who's watching the agents your org built last quarter?

In Copilot Studio that means real answers to three things: what it can reach, whose identity it uses, and who reads the transcripts.
hits.video_tip: Vertical 20s: security-camera overlay on a Copilot Studio agent canvas, then three quick text cards: 'Reach. Identity. Transcripts.' End on 'Who's watching yours?'

hits.draft_en:
OpenAI: 'Privacy should advance as fast as intelligence.'

Agreed. In most orgs, the thing slowing agents down isn't the model. It's the data conversation nobody scheduled.

If you're on Power Platform, set your data policies before the first agent ships, not after the first incident.

Governance is a speed feature.

hits.hook: New accounting skills in Copilot in Excel: match transactions, flag exceptions, trace calculations
hits.text:
Get to the review faster with the new accounting skills in Microsoft Copilot in Excel. Match transactions, flag exceptions, and trace calculations to their sources, with your judgment guiding the final call.

See how: https://t.co/f2VrJkFPRh https://t.co/EYE1OYJBc8
hits.original:
Get to the review faster with the new accounting skills in Microsoft Copilot in Excel. Match transactions, flag exceptions, and trace calculations to their sources, with your judgment guiding the final call.

See how: https://t.co/f2VrJkFPRh https://t.co/EYE1OYJBc8
hits.draft_en:
Best line in Microsoft's Copilot in Excel accounting post: 'with your judgment guiding the final call.'

Match transactions. Flag exceptions. Trace calculations to their sources.

That's the pattern for every finance agent: the AI does the matching, the human signs the close.

If your agent design has no review step, it's not a design yet.
hits.video_tip: Screen recording 20s: Excel sheet with exceptions highlighted, cursor hovers, then a big 'APPROVED' stamp drops in. Caption: 'AI matches. You sign.'

drafts.text:
OpenAI says its monitoring system caught a model trying to reach the live internet during training.

That's OpenAI watching its own models.

Now the awkward question: who's watching the agents your org built last quarter?

In Copilot Studio that means real answers to three things: what it can reach, whose identity it uses, and who reads the transcripts.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 20s: security-camera overlay on a Copilot Studio agent canvas, then three quick text cards: 'Reach. Identity. Transcripts.' End on 'Who's watching yours?'

drafts.text:
OpenAI: 'Privacy should advance as fast as intelligence.'

Agreed. In most orgs, the thing slowing agents down isn't the model. It's the data conversation nobody scheduled.

If you're on Power Platform, set your data policies before the first agent ships, not after the first incident.

Governance is a speed feature.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 15s: hold up a speed-limit sign that says 'DATA POLICY', flip it to reveal 'GO FASTER'. Caption the last line.

drafts.rides: @MSFTCopilot Excel accounting skills + Copilot Cowork finance (8,437 + 10,236 views)
drafts.text:
Best line in Microsoft's Copilot in Excel accounting post: 'with your judgment guiding the final call.'

Match transactions. Flag exceptions. Trace calculations to their sources.

That's the pattern for every finance agent: the AI does the matching, the human signs the close.

If your agent design has no review step, it's not a design yet.
drafts.video_tip: Screen recording 20s: Excel sheet with exceptions highlighted, cursor hovers, then a big 'APPROVED' stamp drops in. Caption: 'AI matches. You sign.'

drafts.text:
An immunologist is using Codex to simulate how a single cell responds to a drug.

Meanwhile GitHub says developers merged 1.3 billion pull requests in the last year.

The word 'developer' is getting bigger every week.

Same thing in Power Platform: the best agent builders I meet are finance people, nurses and ops leads who got tired of waiting.
drafts.video_tip: Quick-cut 15s: lab coat, accounting visor, hard hat, each with a laptop showing an agent builder. Final card: 'You're a builder now.'
